seo.meta_title: 시선 고정 Meaning | 'All Eyes Here' in Korean, from A2O LITE's NEON
seo.meta_description: AI translates 시선 고정 as 'gaze fixation', which sounds medical. It means 'All eyes on this!' — a TV caption and a fun compliment.

ai_failure.situation: A Korean variety show puts the caption 시선 고정 on screen and you ask AI to translate it.
ai_failure.ai_mistake: Gives 'gaze fixation' or 'fixed line of sight', which sounds like an eye exam.
ai_failure.why_it_fails: 시선 고정 is a catchphrase meaning 'All eyes on this' or 'Can't look away'. TV editors use it in captions, and people use it to say something is eye-catching. The phrase appears in A2O LITE's 2026 debut song NEON.

natural_solution.rule: 시선 고정 = can't look away / all eyes here. Its stronger cousin is 시선 강탈 (stealing everyone's attention).

alternatives.context: 'All eyes on this scene!' — a caption or a post
'Your outfit is stealing the show today' — a compliment between friends
'I can feel someone staring' — 시선 on its own, in daily life

nuance: Korean TV captions (자막) use many short, noun-only phrases like this: 시선 고정, 깜짝, 폭소. They read like headlines, without a verb. Learners who watch variety shows will see them constantly.
